watches.name: Sentinel for AMMO NYC
watches.description: Larry Kosilla doesn’t just talk about clean cars - he lives in the details. As the founder of AMMO NYC, his hands have restored, protected, and preserved some of the rarest vehicles in the world. From YouTube tutorials to concours-level work, Larry built his reputation on an uncompromising standard of excellence. But one thing always bugged him: wearing a watch while detailing. The sharp edges, hard surfaces, and exposed metal of traditional tool watches posed too much risk. That’s where Nodus comes in. A crown on the left-side keeps it out of harm’s way when the wrist brushes against fenders or glass. A custom-molded TPU (thermoplastic) bezel is soft to the touch, impact-resistant, and won’t mar a surface if contact is made. An acrylic crystal is used for its lightweight and shatter-resistant properties, ensuring high performance with low risk. Much like Larry’s renowned ability to restore finishes on countless supercars, any scratches on the acrylic crystal can easily be polished out, allowing the watch to maintain its pristine appearance even after rigorous use. The Sentinel is not just a new take on an enthusiast favorite - it’s a tool designed to meet the realities of serious automotive detailing. The Sentinel is designed and assembled in Los Angeles.
